note: Moon nakshatra content for the Vedic chart section of the profile. Deity, symbol, ruling planet (Vimshottari order) and gana are standard reference facts. 'tendency' is written as a tendency, never a prediction.

sources.tone: Dennis Harness, The Nakshatras: The Lunar Mansions of Vedic Astrology (1999): psychological, non-fatalistic tone.
sources.traditional: Varahamihira, Brihat Jataka: results of the Moon in each nakshatra (public-domain English translations from 1885-1919 on archive.org).
sources.status: DRAFT. Written without access to either book (archive.org is blocked from the build environment). Check every entry against the Brihat Jataka and Harness before launch.

Ashwini.deity: the Ashvins, healers of the gods
Ashwini.tendency: You tend to move quickly and like to start things. There is a healing, helping streak in you and an impatience with waiting.

Bharani.deity: Yama, lord of restraint and death
Bharani.tendency: You tend to carry things through to the end and can hold intensity that others avoid. Learning when to restrain yourself and when to let go is a lifelong theme.

Krittika.tendency: You tend to be sharp, honest and purifying: you cut through what's false. Your fire can nourish or burn, depending on how you direct it.

Rohini.tendency: You tend to be drawn to beauty, comfort and growth, and to make things flourish. Watch for holding on to what you love too tightly.

Mrigashira.tendency: You tend to be curious and searching, always looking for the next thing to understand. Your gentleness pairs with restlessness.

Ardra.tendency: You tend to feel deeply and grow through upheaval. Storms in your life often clear the way for something new.

Punarvasu.tendency: You tend to return, renew and begin again after setbacks. You are generous and at home with simplicity.

Pushya.tendency: You tend to nourish and support others, and to feel most yourself when you're caring and being useful. Traditionally one of the most auspicious stars.

Ashlesha.tendency: You tend to be perceptive and intuitive, and you see beneath the surface. Your insight is strong; use it to understand people, not to hold on to them.

Magha.tendency: You tend to feel connected to family, lineage and tradition, and carry a natural dignity. Respect matters to you.

Purva Phalguni.symbol: the front legs of a bed
Purva Phalguni.tendency: You tend to enjoy pleasure, creativity and rest, and bring warmth and charm to relationships. Balancing enjoyment with effort is the theme.

Uttara Phalguni.deity: Aryaman, god of contracts and friendship
Uttara Phalguni.symbol: the back legs of a bed
Uttara Phalguni.tendency: You tend to be dependable and generous, and you keep your commitments. Partnership and helping others succeed are your strengths.

Hasta.tendency: You tend to be skilful and practical, good with your hands and with details. You also have a light, humorous side.

Chitra.tendency: You tend to create and design, and to care about beauty and form. You like to make things that are striking and well made.

Swati.symbol: a young shoot swaying in the wind
Swati.tendency: You tend to value independence and move with change without breaking. Your flexibility is a strength; steady roots let you use it.

Vishakha.tendency: You tend to be goal-focused and determined, and you pursue what you want with single-minded effort. Patience is the lesson.

Anuradha.tendency: You tend to build deep, loyal friendships and to cooperate well. You can flourish in difficult conditions, like a lotus in mud.

Jyeshtha.tendency: You tend to take responsibility and protect those around you. Seniority and authority come to you, and with them the need for humility.

Mula.tendency: You tend to go to the root of things and want the real truth. Sometimes that means pulling up what no longer serves.

Purva Ashadha.tendency: You tend to be persuasive and full of conviction, and you don't give up easily. Your confidence can inspire others.

Uttara Ashadha.tendency: You tend to value integrity and lasting achievement over quick wins. Once you commit, you see it through.

Shravana.tendency: You tend to listen and learn deeply, and you understand through hearing. You connect people and ideas.

Dhanishta.deity: the eight Vasus, gods of abundance
Dhanishta.tendency: You tend to have a sense of rhythm and timing, in music, work or life, and to attract abundance. You work well in groups.

Shatabhisha.tendency: You tend to be independent and private, and drawn to healing and hidden knowledge. Solitude helps you see clearly.

Purva Bhadrapada.tendency: You tend to be intense and idealistic, and ready to sacrifice for what you believe in. Your passion is transformative when grounded.

Uttara Bhadrapada.deity: Ahir Budhnya, serpent of the deep
Uttara Bhadrapada.symbol: the back legs of a funeral cot
Uttara Bhadrapada.tendency: You tend to be deep, calm and self-controlled, with a wisdom that grows over time. Still waters run deep in you.

Revati.tendency: You tend to nourish and guide others, especially on journeys and transitions. There is a gentle, compassionate completeness about you.
